rows.source: Genitive after 'do' / 'konfigurace' (spaced spelling); same genitive form as the written nominative.
Accusative (inanimate, equals nominative); also restores the missing space before the conjunction 'a' in the upstream translation.
Instrumental ('s ...', passive agent 'není ... podporován'); apposition with 'aplikace' avoids the misleading spelling 'CosmoSlicem'.
Genitive (verze, instance, spuštění, aktualizace ...); names ending in silent -ce keep the written -e as the genitive form (cf. Joyce, gen. Joyce).
Dative after 'k'; CosmoSlice (silent final -ce) is left undeclined in an apposition with 'aplikace'.
Locative after 'v' (spaced spelling); undeclined name in an apposition with 'aplikace'.
